original: evaṃ nairṛtāgneyasaṃruddhatvoktyā vāyavyeśānasaṃruddhatvoktyā cāgnau dakṣiṇasyāmuttarasyāṃ ca pūrvapaścimāyatane vedhmaprakṣepaḥ kārya ityarthaḥ siddhyati|

original: nanu pūrvapaścimāntamidhmaprakṣepaḥ svataḥ siddha iti cenna, pūrvaṃ ṣoḍaśedhmaprakṣepaprakaraṇe “īśānāgneyapādābhyāṃ patitaṃ prākcatuṣṭayam" iti, "nairṛtānalasaṃsparśi tṛtīyaṃ viniveśya" iti ca dakṣiṇottarāyatamapīdhmaprakṣepasyoktatvāt| imamarthamavijñāya kasmiṃścit pārameśvaraprayoge vṛthā pāṇḍityaṃ kṛtam|
analyzed: nanu pūrva paścima antam idhma prakṣepaḥ svatas siddhaḥ iti ced na pūrvam ṣoḍaśa idhma prakṣepa prakaraṇe īśāna āgneya pādābhyām patitam prāk catuṣṭayam iti nairṛta anala saṃsparśi tṛtīyam viniveśyaḥ iti ca dakṣiṇa uttara āyatam api idhma prakṣepasya ukta tvāt imam artham a vijñāya kasmiṃścid pārameśvara prayoge vṛthā pāṇḍityam kṛtam

original: tathāhi idhmāṣṭakapakṣe kuṇḍādantaḥ dakṣiṇabhittau madhyata ūrdhvāgramekamidhmaṃ mūlena saṃyojya tathā kuṇḍamadhyata āgneye nairṛte cedhmatritayaṃ nidhāya tathāparacatuṣkamuttarabhittikuṇḍamadhyavāyvīśānakoṇeṣu nidadhyāditi || 143-144 ||
analyzed: tathā hi idhma aṣṭaka pakṣe kuṇḍāt antar dakṣiṇa bhittau madhyatas ūrdhva agram ekam idhmam mūlena saṃyojya tathā kuṇḍa madhyataḥ āgneye nairṛte ca idhma tritayam nidhāya tathā apara catuṣkam uttara bhitti kuṇḍa madhya vāyu īśāna koṇeṣu nidadhyāt iti

original: tato'gnau dakṣiṇe uttare cedhmaprakṣepasthāne tatsaṃkhyānuguṇamājyahomaṃ tatsthānadvayasya sūryasomātmakāgnilocanatvaṃ cāha catuḥsaṃkhyeneti sārdhena| jayākhye tu sūryasomayostattanmantrābhyāmāhutidvārā'gnau dakṣiṇottarayoḥ saṃyojanamuktam| tadapi saṃgṛhītamīśvarapārameśvarayoḥ| kiñca, evamājyabhāgābhyāṃ pūrvamāghārahomo'pi saṃgṛhītastatraiva
analyzed: tatas agnau dakṣiṇe uttare ca idhma prakṣepa sthāne tad saṃkhyā anuguṇam ājya homam tad sthāna dvayasya sūrya soma ātmaka agni locana tvam ca āha catur saṃkhyena iti sārdhena jaya ākhye tu sūrya somayoḥ tad tad mantrābhyām āhuti dvārā agnau dakṣiṇa uttarayoḥ saṃyojanam uktam tat api saṃgṛhītam īśvara pārameśvarayoḥ kiñca evam ājyabhāgābhyām pūrvam āghāra homaḥ api saṃgṛhītaḥ tatra eva

original: etayorantarālasya vadanatvaṃ tatra saptasamidhāṃ hotavyatvaṃ cāha etayoriti| samidhāṃ saptakaṃ samitpuṣpadhūpamadhuparkabījacarughṛtānītyarthaḥ| samidhyate dīpyate'gniranayeti vyutpattyā samitpuṣpādīnāṃ saptānāmapi samidityeva vyavahārāt || 146-147 ||
analyzed: etayoḥ antarālasya vadana tvam tatra sapta samidhām hotavya tvam ca āha etayoḥ iti samidhām saptakam samidh puṣpa dhūpa madhuparka bīja caru ghṛtāni iti arthaḥ samidhyate dīpyate agniḥ anayā iti vyutpattyā samidh puṣpa ādīnām saptānām api samidh iti eva vyavahārāt
ghṛta siktām catur saṃkhyām ekaikām hi su puṣkalām

original: prāk kuṅkumādinā liptāṃ kāṣṭhasaṃkhyāṃ tu homayet |

sraj dhūpam madhuparkam ca bīja anna ājyam yathākramam

samudghāṭya avalokya ādau samprokṣya arghya ambhasā tatas
darbha kāṇḍa catuṣkeṇa sa agninā tat anuspṛśet

dadyāt pūrva prayogeṇa tu evam eva catuṣṭayam
hutvā api anna āhutīnām ca hi ājya ākhyām juhuyāt tatas

original: tāsāṃ homakramamāha ghṛtasiktāṃ catuḥsaṃkhyāmityārabhya ājyākhyāṃ juhuyāt tata ityantam| ghṛtasiktāṃ ghṛtenobhayataḥ siktāmityarthaḥ, "ājyenobhayataḥ siktam" iti pūrvokteḥ| ekaikām pūrvamidhmahomaprakaraṇe catuścatussamidhāṃ yugapat prakṣepasyoktatvādatrāpi tādṛśatvaśaṅkāyā nivṛttyarthamekaikāmityuktam|
analyzed: tāsām homa kramam āha ghṛta siktām catur saṃkhyām iti ārabhya ājya ākhyām juhuyāt tatas ityantam ghṛta siktām ghṛtena ubhayatas siktām iti arthaḥ ājyena ubhayatas siktam iti pūrva ukteḥ ekaikām pūrvam idhma homa prakaraṇe catur catur samidhām yugapad prakṣepasya ukta tvāt atra api tādṛśa tva śaṅkāyāḥ nivṛtti artham ekaikām iti uktam

original: supuṣkalāmityanena kṛmibhakṣitatvādidoṣarāhityamucyate| prāg āsādanakāla ityarthaḥ| kuṅkumādinā, ādiśabdena karpūrakastūryau gṛhyete, sragdhūpamadhuparkaṃ srak puṣpamityarthaḥ| "tataḥ puṣpamayīṃ dadyāt" iti lakṣmītantrokteḥ| dhūpaḥ guggulvādi| madhupa(rka?rkaḥ) saṃmilitapayodadhimadhvājyam| bījāni mudgādīni| annāni pāyasādīni| ājyaṃ goghṛtam|
analyzed: su puṣkalām iti anena kṛmi bhakṣita tva ādi doṣa rāhityam ucyate prāk āsādana kāle iti arthaḥ kuṅkuma ādinā ādi śabdena karpūra kastūryau gṛhyete sraj dhūpa madhuparkam sraj puṣpam iti arthaḥ tatas puṣpa mayīm dadyāt iti lakṣmītantra ukteḥ dhūpaḥ guggulu ādi madhuparka ṛkaḥ saṃmilita payaḥ dadhi madhu ājyam bījāni mudga ādīni annāni pāyasa ādīni ājyam go ghṛtam

original: āhatya sapta samidho jñeyāḥ| yathākramam uktakramamanatikramyetyarthaḥ| pūrvaṃ kāṣṭhasamidham, tataḥ puṣpam, tato dhūpam, tato madhuparkam, tato bījāni, tataścarum, tatastvājyaṃ krameṇa juhuyāditi yāvat| kvacit sātvatapustakeṣu īśvarapārameśvarapustakeṣu ca "bījānyājyaṃ yathākramam" ityaśuddhapāṭho likhitaḥ|
analyzed: āhatya sapta samidhaḥ jñeyāḥ yathākramam ukta kramam an atikramya iti arthaḥ pūrvam kāṣṭha samidham tatas puṣpam tatas dhūpam tatas madhuparkam tatas bījāni tatas carum tatas tu ājyam krameṇa juhuyāt iti yāvat kvacid sātvata pustakeṣu īśvara pārameśvara pustakeṣu ca bījāni ājyam yathākramam iti aśuddha pāṭhaḥ likhitaḥ

original: tadanusāreṇa keṣucit pārameśvaraprayogeṣu bījāhutyanantaramājyāhutistadanantaraṃ carvāhutiriti likhitam, tadasaṃgatam, yataḥ pūrvaṃ sāmānyato'nnasamiddānoktimantarā tatrānnasamidho dāne viśeṣo'yaṃ vidhīyata ityukteravataraṇāsaṃbhavāt, ājyākhyāṃ juhuyāt tata iti carvāhutyanantaramājyākhyasamiddānasyoktatvācca|
analyzed: tad anusāreṇa keṣucid pārameśvara prayogeṣu bīja āhuti anantaram ājya āhutiḥ tad anantaram carva āhutiḥ iti likhitam tat asaṃgatam yatas pūrvam sāmānyatas unna samidh dāna uktim antarā tatra anna samidhaḥ dāne viśeṣaḥ yam vidhīyate iti ukteḥ avataraṇa asaṃbhavāt ājya ākhyām juhuyāt tatas iti carva āhuti anantaram ājya ākhya samidh dānasya ukta tvāt ca

original: prāk saṃskṛtāgnau sādhitamityatra carusādhanaprakārastu dīkṣāprakaraṇe vakṣyamāṇo jñeyaḥ| tanmadhye carumadhye| ājyasya srukcatuṣkaṃ nikṣipet, srucājyena caturvāramabhighāryetyarthaḥ| annagrāsaṃ kukkuṭāṇḍapramāṇamannakabalamityarthaḥ| "kukkuṭāṇḍapramāṇaṃ tu grāsa ityabhidhīyate" iti smṛteḥ|
analyzed: prāk saṃskṛta agnau sādhitam iti atra caru sādhana prakāraḥ tu dīkṣā prakaraṇe vakṣyamāṇaḥ jñeyaḥ tad madhye caru madhye ājyasya sruc catuṣkam nikṣipet srucā ājyena catur vāram abhighārya iti arthaḥ anna grāsam kukkuṭāṇḍa pramāṇam annaka balam iti arthaḥ kukkuṭāṇḍa pramāṇam tu grāsaḥ iti abhidhīyate iti smṛteḥ

original: athādāya srucaṃ tatra tadvad dadyāccatuṣṭayamityatra, tadūrdhve pūrvavadghṛtamityatra, dadyādagnau catuṣkaṃ tu ityatra ca sruveṇeti jñeyam| tato'nnamājyasaṃsiktaṃ prāgvat kṛtvā srucā'jyena caruṃ caturvāramabhighāryetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: atha ādāya srucam tatra tadvat dadyāt catuṣṭayam iti atra tad ūrdhve pūrvavat ghṛtam iti atra dadyāt agnau catuṣkam tu iti atra ca sruveṇa iti jñeyam tatas unnam ājya saṃsiktam prāgvat kṛtvā srucā ājyena carum catur vāram abhighārya iti arthaḥ

original: pūrvaprayogeṇetyanena sruci sruveṇa caturabhighāraḥ, tatra carunikṣepaḥ, tadupari punaścaturabhighārasruveṇājyāhṛticatuṣṭayam, carvāhutyanantaraṃ punaḥ srucā''jyāhuticatuṣṭayaṃ ca saṃgṛhyate| evamannāhutīnāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ hutvetyanenānnāhutīnāmapi catuḥsaṃkhyākatvameva jñeyam|
analyzed: pūrva prayogeṇa iti anena sruci sruveṇa catuḥ abhighāraḥ tatra caru nikṣepaḥ tad upari punar catur abhighāra sruveṇa ājya āhṛti catuṣṭayam caru āhuti anantaram punar srucā ājya āhuti catuṣṭayam ca saṃgṛhyate evam anna āhutīnām catuṣṭayam hutvā iti anena anna āhutīnām api catur saṃkhyāka tvam eva jñeyam

original: evaṃ kāṣṭhasamidho'nnasamidhaśca catuḥsaṃkhyākatvoktyā puṣpādīnāṃ pañcasamidhāmapi catuḥsaṃkhyayā homo jñāyate| pārameśvaravyākhyāne tatprayoge ca ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyayā'nnāhutayastatsaṃkhyayā''jyāhutayaśca pratipāditāḥ| tadbhrāntimūlakam, dadyāt pūrvaprayogeṇa tvevameva catuṣṭayam|
analyzed: evam kāṣṭha samidhā unna samidhaḥ ca catur saṃkhyāka tva uktyā puṣpa ādīnām pañca samidhām api catur saṃkhyayā homaḥ jñāyate pārameśvara vyākhyāne tad prayoge ca ṣoḍaśa saṃkhyayā anna āhutayaḥ tad saṃkhyayā ājya āhutayaḥ ca pratipāditāḥ tad bhrānti mūlakam dadyāt pūrva prayogeṇa tu evam eva catuṣṭayam

original: hutvāpyannāhutīnāṃ tvityannāhuticatuṣṭayasya kaṇṭharaveṇoktatvāt, ekaikānnāhuteḥ purastāt prarastācca catuścatuḥsaṃkhyākriyamāṇājyāhutīnāṃ dvātriṃśatsaṃkhyākatvācca|
analyzed: hutvā api annāhutīnām tu iti annāhuti catuṣṭayasya kaṇṭha raveṇa ukta tvāt ekaika annāhuteḥ purastāt prarastāt ca catur catur saṃkhyā kriyamāṇa ājya āhutīnām dvātriṃśat saṃkhyāka tvāt ca

original: vastutastu bahuśaḥ pārameśvarapustakeṣvasmin prakaraṇe ca catuṣkaṃ tu mantrairājyasya nikṣipedityādi dadyādagnāvityantagranthapātādevaṃ vyākhyātāraḥ prayogakāra prayogakārāśca babhramuriti jñeyam| ata eva pārameśvaravyākhyāne “tatrāntasamidhaviśeṣamāha tatrānnasamidho dāna iti pañcabhiḥ" iti likhitam|
analyzed: vastutas tu bahuśas pārameśvara pustakeṣu asmin prakaraṇe ca catuṣkam tu mantraiḥ ājyasya nikṣipet ityādi dadyāt agnau iti anta grantha pātāt evam vyākhyātāraḥ prayogakāra prayogakārāḥ ca babhramuḥ iti jñeyam atas eva pārameśvara vyākhyāne tatra anta samidha viśeṣam āha tatra anna samidhaḥ dāne iti pañcabhiḥ iti likhitam

original: madhye patitaṃ ślokadvayaṃ na kiñcidapi teṣāmākāṅkṣāpadavīmadhirūḍham || 147-155 ||

pūjayet caturaḥ vārān mantraiḥ vā praṇavaiḥ prabhum

original: tato'gnisthadevānāṃ puṣpaiścaturvāramarcanamāha tadanta iti| arghyamiśritairājyarghyamilitairityarthaḥ, anyathā toyanirmuktairityanena virodhāt| ata evājyenaivārghyadānādikamuktaṃ pādme “arghyapūrvaṃ nivedyāntaṃ sarpiṣā juhuyāt sakṛt" iti| mantraiḥ vāsudevādimantrairityarthaḥ| yadvā praṇavaiḥ, bahuvacanena caturvāramuccaritairityarthaḥ|
analyzed: tatas agni stha devānām puṣpaiḥ catur vāram arcanam āha tad ante iti arghya miśritaiḥ āji arghya militaiḥ iti arthaḥ anyathā toya nirmuktaiḥ iti anena virodhāt atas eva ājyena eva arghya dāna ādikam uktam pādme arghya pūrvam nivedya antam sarpiṣā juhuyāt sakṛt iti mantraiḥ vāsudeva ādi mantraiḥ iti arthaḥ yat vā praṇavaiḥ bahuvacanena catur vāram uccaritaiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: mūrtimantrāḥ prativyaktivibhinnāḥ, praṇavastu vyāpakatvāt sarveṣāmeka eveti bhāvaḥ| atra praṇavairityanenāṣṭākṣarādayaścatvāro mantrā apyupalakṣyante, teṣāmapi praṇavārthavivaraṇarūpatayā vyāpakatvāt, teṣu praṇavapadamantratvenoktatvācca| tathā ca lakṣmītantre
analyzed: mūrti mantrāḥ prati vyakti vibhinnāḥ praṇavaḥ tu vyāpaka tvāt sarveṣām ekaḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ atra praṇavaiḥ iti anena aṣṭa akṣara ādayaḥ catvāraḥ mantrāḥ api upalakṣyante teṣām api praṇava artha vivaraṇa rūpatayā vyāpaka tvāt teṣu praṇava pada mantra tvena ukta tvāt ca tathā ca lakṣmītantre

original: iti vāsudevādyuddeśena caturdhā vibhaktānāmidhmānāṃ tanmantrairarcanīyatve'pi dvādaśākṣarasya vyāpakatvād dvādaśākṣaravidyayetyuktam| evaṃ bhadrapīṭhaśodhanaprakaraṇe'pi “prakṣālya dvādaśārṇena praṇavādyantakena tu" ityuktam|
